notes: Reference questions are optional; never require completion before booking.
Readiness is a customer preference, not a construction timeline promise.
Yes to financing means either financing option; do not infer cash versus loan.
Name, phone, email and signature are not required to begin a conversation.
Location, budget amounts, square footage, layout, contact information and scheduling details are collected in chat, not in this form.
number follows the discovery order; sourceNumber preserves the original PDF question number.
The form restores all 19 reference questions except specialist_call. Planning help is first and land ownership is second; playful questions close the form.

Use saved answers to choose one relevant chat follow-up. Ask about an owned lot only after land_owned=yes. Skip irrelevant or already answered questions; do not turn the form into another checklist in chat.

questions.question: Would you like help figuring out where to start?
questions.formQuestion: Would you like help figuring out where to start?

questions.question: Do you already own the land?
questions.formQuestion: Do you already own the land?
questions.chatWhen: After Yes, ask for lot area if not already known. After No, unknown or skipped, do not ask for land size or site-preparation details. Desired home size is a separate preference.

questions.question: Is the lot ready to build, including clearing, survey and utilities?
questions.formQuestion: Is the lot ready to build (cleared, surveyed, utilities available)?
questions.chatWhen: Only if the customer owns land and site preparation is relevant.

questions.question: Do you already have a designer?
questions.formQuestion: Do you already have a designer?

questions.question: Do you have complete blueprints?
questions.formQuestion: Do you have complete blueprints?

questions.question: Have you set a budget for your new home?
questions.formQuestion: Have you set a budget for your new home?

questions.question: Is financing in place, through loan pre-approval or cash?
questions.formQuestion: Are you pre-approved for a loan, or paying cash?
questions.chatWhen: Only if financing becomes relevant after discussing the budget; do not lead with financial screening.

questions.question: Would you like to start building within six months?
questions.formQuestion: Do you want to start building within 6 months?

questions.question: Would you like to start building right away?
questions.formQuestion: Do you want to start building right away?
questions.chatWhen: Clarify urgency in chat only when relevant; do not repeat the six-month question.

questions.question: Are you hoping to have the home completed within one year?
questions.formQuestion: Does your home need to be completed within 1 year?
questions.chatWhen: Ask about a specific deadline in chat only when timeline matters; never promise feasibility.

questions.question: Do you need to sell your current home first?
questions.formQuestion: Do you need to sell your current home first?

questions.question: Do you have a real estate agent?
questions.formQuestion: Do you have a real estate agent?
questions.chatWhen: Only when land purchase or selling the current home is discussed.

questions.question: Will anyone else be making decisions with you?
questions.formQuestion: Will anyone else be making decisions with you?

questions.question: Have you built a custom home before?
questions.formQuestion: Have you built a custom home before?
questions.chatWhen: Only when prior building experience would help tailor an answer.

questions.question: Do you need landscape design?
questions.formQuestion: Do you need landscape design?
questions.chatWhen: Only when outdoor space or landscaping is relevant to the project.

questions.question: Would you like a patio, deck or outdoor living area?
questions.formQuestion: Do you need a backyard built (patio, deck, outdoor living)?
questions.chatWhen: Only when the customer discusses outdoor living requirements.

questions.question: Would you like a rooftop deck or terrace?
questions.formQuestion: Do you want a rooftop deck or terrace?
questions.chatWhen: Only when rooftop space is relevant to the desired layout.

questions.question: Did you enjoy our reels?
questions.formQuestion: Did you enjoy our reels? :)
questions.chatWhen: Optional playful closing in the form. Acknowledge warmly if useful; never treat this answer as buying intent, a booking request or permission to contact others.

questions.question: Will you invite us to your housewarming party?
questions.formQuestion: Will you invite us to your housewarming party? :)
questions.chatWhen: Optional playful closing in the form. Acknowledge warmly if useful; never treat this answer as buying intent, a booking request or permission to contact others.

questions.question: Would you like a free initial consultation with a member of our team?
questions.formQuestion: Would you like to schedule a free initial consultation with a specialist?
questions.chatWhen: Invite a free initial consultation in chat only after discovery readiness allows it, or when the customer explicitly asks. Never include this in the form.
